# Twist & Thrive Systems

> Twist & Thrive Systems is a one-person practice in Boulder County, Colorado, run by Gina Harrison. It builds intake forms, client dashboards, automation, event sites, and websites for small independent businesses, in five levels that build on each other. Pricing is fixed per deliverable, never hourly. Every engagement starts with a free 20-minute Discovery Call.

Founder: Gina Harrison. 15+ years in customer experience and operations at Conga, Movable Ink, and Swrve. Certified Dementia Practitioner.
Location: Boulder County, CO. Serves Boulder, Lafayette, Louisville, Denver, and remote clients across the US.
Contact: consultwithatwist@gmail.com. Book a call: https://calendly.com/twistandthrivesystems

## Pricing
Five levels that build on each other. Each level includes everything before it.
- Time Leak Quiz: free 3-minute self-check at https://twistandthrive.com/quiz. No email needed for results.
- Discovery Call: free, 20 minutes.
- Clarity Audit: $450; credited in full toward any level started within 30 days.
- Level 1, Intake: from $2,500. Branded intake or application form linked from Instagram or a website, one queue, automatic confirmation, approve or decline. Example: K5 Dog Services.
- Level 2, Dashboard: from $4,500. Client records, statuses, services assigned, notes. Examples: Reclaim & Renew, Nurture Sync.
- Level 3, Checks and balances: from $7,000. Approvals and sign-offs, matching against availability, handoffs between people, document review. Example: K5 Dog Services matching and document scanning.
- Level 4, Automate: from $9,500. Reminders, notifications, editable lifecycle emails, status updates.
- Level 5, Full system: from $14,000. Multiple user types, outside reviewers, scoring, reporting, settings.
- Add-ons, any level: Payments (Stripe) from $750; Website from $2,000 for up to 3 pages; Brand basics from $1,000; Pricing and offers from $1,200. Outreach and launch planning on request.
- Hosting and care: from $150/month. Monthly Access (ongoing builds): from $750/month, three-month minimum.
- Payments over $1,000 can be split into two or three installments. Delivery dates are set in each written scope.
- Does not build systems that store people's medical or health records.
